scope.population: Rights-pass documents selected from the frozen English Wikipedia sampling frame and their candidate-independently annotated VPC.full, VPC.semi, and VID occurrences.
scope.claim_boundary: Population estimates apply only to the frozen sampling population. The single source genre does not support cross-genre, national-variety, learner-language, or all-English inference.
scope.current_evidence: Protocol only; no source row, sampled document, human label, system prediction, interval, or performance estimate exists.

browser_descriptive_metric_contract.boundary: Its browser lexical-diversity outputs remain descriptive and cannot be substituted for the separately versioned benchmark_mwe_evaluation contract.

units_and_dependence.annotation_segment: One retained prose paragraph nested within one document.

primary_cluster.reason: Paragraphs, candidates, and occurrences from one article share topic, wording, editorial history, and preprocessing decisions.
primary_cluster.required_use: IR-126 intervals and paired system comparisons resample documents within sampling length strata; all records from a sampled document travel together.

secondary_cluster.reason: Repeated occurrences of one lexical type share form, inventory, and learned lexical evidence across documents.
secondary_cluster.required_use: Report a canonical-form-cluster sensitivity analysis. Any unseen-form claim uses canonical form as the split and analysis unit, not occurrence count.

prohibitions: Do not treat occurrences, candidates, paragraphs, or repeated forms as independent observations.
Do not let one document fragment or one canonical type cross a split whose claim requires that cluster to be held out.
Do not increase an effective sample size by counting multiple senses, annotator decisions, or system predictions for one occurrence as new observations.

category.assignment: Use the frozen project-to-PARSEME mapping. Rejected and unresolved candidates are not forced into a positive category and remain in their own candidate-status denominators.

continuity.assignment: continuous when the adjudicated member span has zero gap_token_ids; discontinuous when it has one or more.

form_exposure.assignment: After IR-123 freezes splits, development_seen means the canonical_type_id occurs in any training, pilot, or development gold available to system developers; test_unseen means it does not. Dictionary presence alone does not make a form development-seen. Indeterminate receives no unseen-form claim.

variant.assignment: Ordinary verbal inflection is lemma-normalized and is not a variant. verified_variant requires a source-declared or project-adjudicated same-type link under the hybrid inventory contract; unresolved_variant is descriptive only.

source_genre.assignment: Constant by design. No between-genre estimate or genre-general claim is available in version 1.0.0.

sampling_length.assignment: Reuse the exact 500-999, 1000-1999, and 2000-3999 project-token boundaries in resources/sampling_frame.json.

claim_denominators.denominator: All adjudicated confirmed target occurrences in discovery-complete evaluation documents, including occurrences missed by every automatic or assisted candidate source.

Recall uses all adjudicated confirmed target occurrences; precision uses all system-proposed evaluation candidates. Category scoring uses confirmed occurrences with an adjudicated VPC.full, VPC.semi, or VID label; unresolved candidates are counted and reported separately.

All adjudicated candidate records scheduled for idiomaticity assessment, including retained literal negatives. Ambiguous and not-assessed states remain visible; any determinate-only accuracy uses a separately named subset.
Report separately over all confirmed target occurrences and over all distinct canonical_type_ids represented by them. Unresolved and out-of-inventory records stay in both applicable denominators.

Coverage uses all confirmed occurrences requiring a sense decision. Assignment scoring uses the separately reported subset with an adjudicated non-out-of-inventory reference set; ambiguity and system abstention never disappear from coverage.
All records independently assigned to at least two annotators for the named task before adjudication; occurrence, span, category, idiomaticity, and sense denominators are reported separately.
All assigned documents reaching the declared completion or stop state. Candidate and confirmed-occurrence counts remain nested workload descriptors rather than independent cases.

aggregation_and_weighting.overall_population_estimate: Use the frozen stratum inclusion probability pi_h=n_h/N_h and weight each sampled document by 1/pi_h. An unweighted pooled score describes only the realized benchmark composition.
aggregation_and_weighting.within_length_stratum: Rows have equal first-order inclusion probability after rights filtering; task metrics may be aggregated within the stratum using the IR-125 formula.
aggregation_and_weighting.required_reports: Report overall results and every prespecified single-axis stratum with its numerator, denominator, distinct document count, distinct canonical-form count, estimate state, and interval state.
aggregation_and_weighting.crossed_cells: The full Cartesian product is not a required inferential family. Crossed cells are descriptive unless IR-127 prospectively names and powers one before sealed-test access.
aggregation_and_weighting.combined_score: Forbidden. Candidate, span, category, idiomaticity, inventory, sense, abstention, agreement, and burden remain separate.

small_stratum_rule.current_state: Every stratum is descriptive-only until IR-127 freezes its required allocation and cluster-count threshold from pre-test pilot simulation.
small_stratum_rule.inferential_promotion: Before sealed-test access, IR-127 must name the stratum, show a feasible design targeting a 95% interval half-width no greater than 0.10, and freeze the minimum analyzable document count plus any canonical-form count required by the claim.
small_stratum_rule.automatic_withhold: Report counts and point estimates as descriptive only when the frozen minimum cluster count is not met, the denominator is zero, the metric is undefined, or the realized 95% interval exceeds the frozen precision target. Do not pool strata or relax the target after seeing results.
small_stratum_rule.overall_target: IR-127 separately targets a 95% interval half-width no greater than 0.05 for each named overall primary estimate.
small_stratum_rule.degenerate_case: With fewer than two resampling clusters, report counts only and no bootstrap interval or comparative inference.

next_gates: IR-123 freezes document-disjoint splits and any canonical-form-disjoint unseen-form test.
IR-125 benchmark metric contract 1.1.0-predata freezes task formulas, undefined cases, and input schemas without changing these strata post hoc.

IR-126 bootstrap contract 1.0.0-predata and its standard-library implementation provide stratified document-cluster resampling, canonical-form sensitivity, and paired comparisons without supplying any observed interval.
IR-127 freezes allocation and claim-withhold thresholds before document selection or sealed-test access.
change_rule: Changing a stratum definition, cluster unit, weighting rule, denominator boundary, or small-stratum gate requires a new protocol version and decision-log record. After test exposure, the change applies only to a new sealed evaluation version.
